name: Nicole
source: A Santa Claus (dunce) who announces "I came from Finland!".　She's weak against heat and asks the protagonist to help her deliver presents when she becomes lost on the island of everlasting summer. She is considerably sluggish and lazes about the protagonist's home, despite being a freeloader. She's always with her friend (Arto) who is a reindeer.
